content:
The image shows a mango leaf that is completely brown, desiccated, and curled/rolled upward along its length. There is no green tissue remaining.

Key observations:
- Leaf is entirely necrotic and brown
- Leaf is curled upwards (rolled along the midrib)
- No black sooty coating (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No distinct lesion spots or sunken spots (rules out Anthracnose)
- The upward curling, browning, and withering matches Die_Back symptoms exactly: "leaves curl upwards and fall off," "veins turning brown causing leaves to curl upwards"
